description: Custom line items and notes under the line, kept in the order sent. Wherefour always works out custom line item prices; a new custom line item that doesn't qualify is left off the line. Find custom line definition IDs with `GET /settings/custom_line_definitions`. Existing details that aren't sent are kept.

id.description: Required when editing or removing an existing detail

kind.description: Required when adding a new detail

internal_note.description: Set to true for a note meant for your team only

id.description: Required when editing an existing custom line item

custom_line_definition_id.description: Required for a new custom line item

count.description: Required for a new custom line item

_destroy.description: Setting this to true will remove the specified detail
